content:
Liz (Finance): Heads up — StratoCare pinged about invoice INV-9134. They were charged a cross-region burst during a regional maintenance window (mar 2026-03-20). Amount looks small but customer expects regional-only dedicated billing. Can infra confirm?
Priya (Sales): Customer is upset. Quote: "We paid for EU-dedicated capacity; shipping traffic to other regions without consent is unacceptable. Please refund the burst charges."
Omar (Eng Infra): Quick findings: eu-2 had a maintenance rollback at 2026-03-20T11:12Z which caused smart-router to fail traffic into our shared-us pools for ~18 minutes. Most requests hit queued shared hosts, generating metered burst on us-east-1.
Omar (Eng Infra): Meter extract:
``nmetric: dedicated_shared_burst.tokens
customer: stratocare
period: 2026-03-20T11:12Z - 2026-03-20T11:30Z
value: 45,678
route: us-east-1
cause: eu-2-maintenance -> fallback
```
Raj (Billing): Invoice excerpt:
``nINV-9134
reserved_commit: 2,500,000 tokens @ committed rate
lineitem: cross_region_burst 45,678 tokens @ $0.0009 = $41.11
```
Nina (Support): Customer insists they had set region_pin=true on initial setup. We don't see that flag recorded on their dedicated pool config; looks like they assumed pinning was automatic.
Liz (Finance): Contract check: SOW stmt. 3.1 says we may route for reliability but customers can request regional-only behavior. It does not explicitly require prior consent for fallback during maintenance. Options: (A) bill as-is, (B) reverse burst charge, (C) reverse + SLA goodwill. What's recommendation?
Priya (Sales): Recommend reversing the $41.11 and a $25 goodwill credit to keep retention high — low cost to us, high PR value.
Omar (Eng Infra): Engineering acknowledges we didn't display fallback policy clearly in the console. We will: 1) add a regional_pin=true default for new dedicated pools (3 business days), 2) add a visible banner in console about cross-region fallback (1 week). We'll own that.
Raj (Billing): For reconciliation: if we issue $66.11 total credit, we need GL code and whether to issue credit memo or invoice reversal. I prefer credit memo to keep audit trail.
Liz (Finance): Approved credit memo $66.11. GL: CUST_CR_OPS_02. Note: "Credit issued for cross-region burst during maintenance; improved documentation/console flag scheduled."
BillingBot: credit_memo_created: CM-2026-0456 amount:$66.11 linked_invoice:INV-9134
Nina (Support): I'll send StratoCare the CM ID and a note apologizing, and include timeline for infra fixes.
Priya (Sales): Thanks — will follow up with an account check-in.
Omar (Eng Infra): I'll post the infra remediation RFC in eng-infra and tag support/sales. ETA for flag rollout: 3 business days for default change, banner up by next Tuesday.
Liz (Finance): Closing the loop — credit memo CM-2026-0456 queued. I'll update billing ledgers after posting.
Priya (Sales): Closing: customer response pending; will escalate if they ask for additional SLA credits.
